name: Ero
source:
The tallest of the 4 seme! He is a particoular psychologist (called by Battista) who decides to live with Bali until he’ll go back to the social life. Bali hasn’t a great relationship with psychologists, that’s why he hates him and would like to kick his ass all the day. But Ero has a special weapon, the “Sweet-attack”, which turns down any evil intent and protects him from Bali’s rage.
He and Pricasso are a bit like dog and cat…and he wins like the dog.
Houseworks and cooking are his favourite activities.
But, under this thick sweetness and lovelyness layer, there’s a dark and terrible secret…
